text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in our DM. I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it on 4 Oct and Thea Ramaswell confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet," which has no date. Gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags. It was escalated to tier-2 support. Because the note is undated, I told Dana I can't say whether it's still open.

I read all six of Moss's notes in the shared files, which are public. Two other North notes mention the account but give no ticket numbers. The tickets in the two Central notes belong to Central accounts, not Quarrendon. I left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (one "r"), because Moss's cheat sheet says that company is a different business and not a customer. I didn't read any channels or use message search.
